title: Haywood County radio host captures possible UFO sighting on video
excerpt: A local radio host sent us footage of a possible UFO sighting.
content:
HAYWOOD COUNTY, Tenn. (WBBJ) - A local radio host sent us footage of a possible UFO sighting. The video comes from WTBG’s Mickey Utley, host of ‘The Suppressed Signal’ which is a paranormal and extraterrestrial themed talk show. Utley was in Haywood County north of Brownsville looking to the northwest toward Halls. The footage captures what appears to be a plane soaring in the night sky, but it vanishes without a trace and reappears moments later.

Utley describes the sighting

“It was really quiet and it was really dark, It was like a star or something that was really bright, but it was low on the horizon and it just started fading in and out,” says Utley.

According to the National UFO Reporting Center in Davenport, Washington, this would be the 6th UFO reported in the Brownsville area since 2000 and the first since 2023. Utley, wanting more witnesses, got his wife to see the airborne spectacle.

“I ran and got my wife because I just didn’t want to be the only one to see it you know, so I got her and she went out there and her jaw hit the ground for like 10 seconds. It was amazing, and so we come back out and they were gone,” Utley tells us.

A special interest

The radio host has alerts set up across several apps to see satellites as well as other air and spacecraft passing over the area.

Utley describes his interest into the matter, “I even have the app for the Space Station. It alerts me. That’s how much I’m into it. It alerts me, but it didn’t go off, Starlink didn’t go off. There was nothing around in that area, no thunderstorms, just these crazy lights all over the place.”

Utley is an amateur drone pilot as well and has reason to believe drones can also be ruled out.
